description: Confirm a prepared mint on Base. Verifies the protocol-fee mint and, when recipient_tx_hash is set (or the fee receipt already contains the recipient mint), writes customer_tier_status so get_token_balance leaves 0. Same hash for both fields when EIP-5792 batched the calls. A second call with recipient_tx_hash still credits the customer after the fee is already settled.

fee_tx_hash.description: Transaction hash of the protocol fee mint

mint_intent_id.description: Optional mint_intent_id from the mint response; links this exact intent when several pending mints share token, recipient and amount.

obligation_id.description: fee_obligation_id returned by mint_loyalty_tokens or earn_points

recipient_tx_hash.description: Transaction hash of the mint to the recipient. Same as fee_tx_hash when both mints are in one transaction. Required to update GET /balance.

name: confirm_mint_fee
title: Confirm Mint Fee
